title: The coord hook rewrites its state file in place and has no total deadline, so parallel tool calls can read a half-written state and a locked store runs each call to the 10 second kill
goal: the coord hook writes its state file by replacing it whole and stops its coord calls once a total deadline under its 10 second budget has passed

run:
import re
text = open('.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
atomic = 'os.replace' in text
deadline = bool(re.search(r'DEADLINE|deadline', text))
print('state replaced whole:', atomic, '| total deadline:', deadline)
import sys
sys.exit(0 if atomic and deadline else 1)

repro_reason: a torn read needs two hook processes inside one write; a locked store needs a held write lock past the call limits
